pr_title: ADR 0131: integrate managed validation with agent runs
pr_body:
## Summary

- add engine-owned managed validation attempts and fixed Cargo gates derived from the immutable AgentProposal validation plan
- persist provider-independent validation events/results, interruption recovery, cancellation, and structured process failures
- keep arbitrary commands outside the managed allow-list unresolved instead of executing them or bypassing ArbitraryCommandExecution permission
- drive AgentRun Validating/Repairing/Playtesting/Evaluating transitions and CompletionReport source validation from the host
- make AI Studio display completion state without implementing validation semantics in the UI

## Validation

Expected Windows validation scope: affected engine-editor. Visual validation is required because Completion contract controls become read-only status presentation.
